description:
In this video, Miguel Santirso, General Manager at Voodoo, and Miguel Tomé, Technical Director, discuss how the studio balances future game development with the needs of their current playerbase in their live game, _Mob Control_.

Play Mob Control: https://on.unity.com/MobControl

[0:00] - Intro
[0:46] - Managing player configurations across updates
[1:35] - Delivering new content

The Cinemachine Third Person Aim camera is a virtual camera setup that lets you aim from a third-person perspective by rotating around your character and aligning the view with the aiming direction. In this tip, we’ll show you how to set that up.

Watch our Cinemachine video tutorial series: https://on.unity.com/CinemachineTutorials
